Potential charges: "放火罪" (arson) or "非法使用火种罪"? In Chinese law, causing forest fire is "放火罪" (arson) under Criminal Law article 114 (dangerous arson). Also there is "危害公共安全罪" maybe. For forest fire, there is "非法占用林地" not. The typical charge for causing forest fire is "放火罪" (arson) or "过失放火罪"? Actually article 115: "过失纵火" maybe.
